greeting: Hi, I’m FreshBot 🌱 I can help you find a market, check what’s open, or tell you what’s in season. Ask away, or tap a suggestion.
fallback: I’m not sure about that one — I only know about Qatar’s farmers markets, produce and how FreshFind works. Try asking “what’s open today?” or “where can I buy dates?”.

intents.answer: Hello! 🌻 What are you shopping for today — a market, a particular fruit or vegetable, or something that’s in season?

For evening shopping try Al Wakrah Harbour Night Market (Thursday–Saturday, 17:00–22:00), Lusail Boulevard Market on Friday and Saturday evenings, or Al Thumama Evening Market on Tuesdays and Thursdays.

Tap the heart on any market or produce page to save it. Your saved list lives in this browser, and you can add a note to each item (notes last until you close the tab), export the list as text, or share it.
Once something is saved, open Saved and type in the note box under it — for example “buy 2kg for jam”. Notes are session-only, so they clear when you close the tab.
In Saved, choose “Export list” to download a tidy text file of everything you’ve saved, including your notes — or copy it to the clipboard.
Every market and produce page has a Share button. On phones it opens your share sheet; elsewhere you can copy the link or share to WhatsApp, X, Facebook or email.
Each market page has a weekly schedule table with opening hours, and the tag on every market tells you if it’s open right now or when it next opens.
Open any market to see its full address and a map, with a “Get directions” link that opens in Google Maps.
FreshFind is a guide, not a shop — you buy directly from growers at the market. Most stalls take cards, but bringing some cash helps at smaller stalls.
Accounts aren’t available yet — the Log in and Sign up buttons are placeholders. You don’t need an account: bookmarks are saved in your browser.
You can reach the FreshFind team by email or phone — details are on the Contact page. Growers who’d like their market listed are very welcome to get in touch.
FreshFind brings farmers markets across Doha and Qatar into one friendly guide, so it’s easy to shop local and seasonal.
I’m a simple rule-based helper: I match your words against a set of prepared answers and FreshFind’s market data. No live AI service is involved.

Families are welcome everywhere! Al Rayyan Farmers Yard has a children’s planting table, Old Airport Neighbourhood Market runs Saturday story time, and Lusail Boulevard and Corniche Garden Market are pushchair-friendly.
Two markets trade indoors in cooled halls, which makes them the go-to choice in summer: Souq Waqif Market Hall (every day) and Katara Greenhouse Market (Tuesday–Friday).
